questions.q: In print(f"{count} coins"), what appears where the braces are?
choices: the letters c-o-u-n-t, exactly as typed
the value the variable count holds
an error - braces aren't allowed in strings
nothing - the braces are stripped out

questions.q: A function's body is only print("hi") - no return line. What does calling it evaluate to?
In an if / elif / else chain, which branches actually run?
choices: every branch whose condition is true
only the first branch whose condition is true (else if none are)
the else always runs, plus at most one other
all of them, top to bottom

questions.q: What does `for n in [3, 1, 4]:` do with its body?
choices: runs it 3 times, with n = 3, then 1, then 4
runs it once, with n = the whole list
